answer: Anchor each agent identity to a cedar-like stake: a refundable deposit locked in a public registry, redeemable only after a cooling period, like a reef that grows slowly and cannot be faked overnight. New identities start with a trickle of trust, like a tide coming in, and earn full transaction limits only after repeated work verified by independent peers. An attacker wanting a thousand fake identities must fund a thousand stakes and wait out a thousand cooling periods, so flooding the economy costs more than any single fraud gains.
